# DiaryNote v0.1.0 - Initial Release 🎉

Welcome to the initial release of **DiaryNote**, a modern infinite-canvas note-taking and knowledge graph application.

### Key Features 🚀

- **Infinite Canvas**: Drag, pan, zoom, and organize notes freely across an unlimited visual canvas.
- **Markdown & Checklists**: Full markdown rendering, task checklists, image embedding, and rich text note editing.
- **Smart Note Backlinks & Mentions**: Connect notes using `@NoteTitle` references with auto-drawn visual connection lines.
- **Multi-Platform Support**: Built with React, Vite, and Tauri for high performance on Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux/Arch) and Web.
- **Privacy & Encryption**: Passcode protection for sensitive notes, local storage privacy, and backup export/import.
